verdict.rationale: kitty is strongly scriptable: the remote-control docs describe driving it from scripts, and a hands-on probe ran `kitty --detach --listen-on` with `kitten @ ls/send-text/get-text/close-window` as a full external automation loop. Nothing shows it running truly headless (no display) or inside a CI pipeline, so it supports scripted automation of a live GUI instance rather than the story as written. Missing for 10: documented headless/no-display mode, CI usage guidance or examples, independent corroboration of CI or headless runs.
